caption: The drawing depicts two cylindrical objects on a plain, off-white background. Both objects appear to be stoneware pieces. The larger object, positioned in the lower center, is a brown and tan cylinder with slight variations in color that suggest glazing or wear. It has a circular indentation on the top surface and four smaller dark circles that may be holes or decorative marks arranged around the indentation. On the side of the cylinder is an oval label that reads: "C. CROLIUS STONEWARE MANUFACTURE MANHATTAN-WELLS NEW YORK." The smaller object, located above and slightly to the right of the larger one, is a lighter, cream-colored cylinder with a similar circular indentation on top and the word "FOUNTAIN" printed on its side in black capital letters with a decorative flourish beneath the text. Both objects are rendered with attention to detail, depicting their three-dimensional forms and surface textures. The artist's signature "chas. Socar" is visible in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Inkwell
